objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed paperless document with properties, content, versions, release, distribution, validity, archiving and translation support.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Corresponding document type selected when creating a new document.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Document property maintained to link documents to master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Document property maintained to link documents to master data or other documents.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Document property maintained via document properties.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Document property maintained via document properties.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document using TAG technology.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document using TAG technology and shown in workflow/status reports.

attributes.name: scopes
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document using TAG technology.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: Attribute used for assigning reader authorizations via user group assignment.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Attribute for assigning the author; the creator is automatically confirmed in this field by default.

attributes.name: co_authors
attributes.description: Attribute for additional personal change rights.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Attribute for assigning releasers, including translation.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which document validity is calculated after release.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period used to calculate the valid until date.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Archive period defined for each document type.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: Attribute affecting e-mail notification when the next version is released.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Attribute affecting distribution of acknowledgement workflow task when the next version is released.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: Document type for company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Document type describing locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Document type describing specific procedures, process sequence, details and responsible persons within a framework.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Document type for documenting special detailed work steps usually relevant for a few departments.

objs.name: form
objs.description: Document type that can supplement work instructions.

objs.name: checklist
objs.description: Document type that can supplement work instructions.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selectable when creating new objects.

objs.name: information_object
objs.description: Object attached when creating new documents or additional document-related objects.

objs.name: object_cover
objs.description: Pure cover object to which external files or documents can be uploaded or new documents generated.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: File uploaded to an object cover.

objs.name: source_format
objs.description: Existing source format used to open a document in the corresponding local Office component.

objs.name: pdf
objs.description: Converted web-displayed representation of the saved document.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attached to a main document and automatically released with the main document release.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Additional information object used to describe documents in more detail and released directly via switches in properties.

objs.name: equipment
objs.description: Document attachment/additional relevant equipment mentioned as supplement to documents.

objs.name: authorization_group
objs.description: Group defined in the system and assigned to documents to give read and change rights to users/persons.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group of users used for roles, reader authorization, distribution and archive access.

objs.name: person
objs.description: Individual user/person assigned authorizations or distribution.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Individual system user participating in roles, workflows, dashboards or distribution.

objs.name: reader
objs.description: Role/user group whose users can view approved objects and documents.

objs.name: author
objs.description: Role/person with read and write permissions and who signs creation of the document in the workflow.

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: Person with additional personal change rights and no relevance within the release workflow.

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: Role/person checking document content according to technical and formal aspects.

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: Role/person responsible for the document and its content and deciding distribution to readers.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: Role/person that can translate released content into another language.

objs.name: creator
objs.description: Person who creates a document, request or proposal and may be defaulted as author or initiator.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal for an existing document that can be created and managed without affecting content or version history.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document before validity expires and processed with workflow support.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: Request created to invalidate a selected document.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to re-validate invalidated documents.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to workflow participants for release, acknowledgement or other workflow-supported processing.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature used by workflow participants and documented for each released version.

objs.name: e_mail_notification
objs.description: Notification sent by the system to users involved in workflows, proposals, release or distribution.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List of user groups and persons assigned to distribution for a document.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation requested from persons/users on distribution and documented for current document version.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: User and role-specific dashboard filled based on distribution groups and showing relevant documents.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation report/search for documents and instructions.

objs.name: instruction
objs.description: Instruction stored in the system and evaluated in status reports.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Translated or original language-dependent version of a released document.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system where document visibility can be specified.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Master data object with which documents can be linked.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Master data object with which documents can be linked.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Master data object with which documents can be linked.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Master data such as IT applications to which documents can be linked.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: Example of master data linked to documents.

objs.name: company
objs.description: Relevant company maintained as a document property.

objs.name: area_of_validity
objs.description: Area of validity maintained as a document property.

objs.name: department
objs.description: Organizational context for which detailed work steps may be relevant.

objs.name: business_admin_group
objs.description: Group permitted to create requests for reactivation.

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: Specific user group retaining read access to archived documents.
